strings.name: Patrick Pouyanné
strings.summary: Pouyanné moved from French public administration into exploration, production and refining. CEO since 2014 and chair since 2015, he expanded LNG, power and renewables while continuing oil and gas investment. His strategy remains debated in relation to supply security, returns and climate goals; the 2021 name change expresses that business direction.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Leads TotalEnergies and investment adjustments across global oil, gas, LNG and electricity businesses.
